name: Eugene
source:
[i]"There is more value in prayer than in pleasure. So, just once a day is okay. Pray for my happiness before you go to sleep."[/i]

[i]Amorist of the End[/i]

A sociable and understanding trader. He lives uninhibited and honest to his own desires. That cheerfulness and a deep sense of sympathy bring both vigor and harmony to Vy-xen.

Though he pours his affection into others equally, a poison lurks within. All he reveals about his Gift is that he's lost it.

He shows no interest in the heroine's mission or her filial devotion, only showing an unhealthy concern for her the moment she fails and falls to despair. Sweet whispers and mischievous fingers have her at his mercy.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=eugene]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
